findings.title: [P2] Preserve empty-name outputs
findings.body: For `{ name: "" }` or a whitespace-only name, the previous nullish fallback returned the trimmed empty string. Replacing `??` with `||` now returns `"Anonymous"`, changing an existing boundary-input contract despite the PR's stated intent to preserve contracts. Keep the nullish fallback unless this behavior change is intentional and covered as a new contract.
